name: Toriko
source:
Three digital novels.

Lucia, the protagonist's fiancee, is trained as a slave by Royd, the antagonist (Screenshots 2-6).

The protagonist never got a chance to profess his love for the heroine and spends his days in envy. Then, a mysterious package arrives (Screenshots 7-8).

The protagonist wakes up in some kind of institution. His memory is gone. Something must have happened (Screenshots 9-10).

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031619.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
三部數位小說。主角的未婚妻露西亞被反派洛伊德調教成奴隸（截圖2-6）。主角從未有機會向女主角告白，整日在嫉妒中度過。然後，一個神秘的包裹送到了（截圖7-8）。主角在某種機構中醒來。他的記憶消失了。一定發生了什麼事（截圖9-10）。

［來自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031619.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
